content.text:
`/output/final-findings.md` is written (2896 bytes). No P0 was established.

The review accepts the SYSTEM-subset result at P4 and does not raise it. Both runs saw a well-formed `ok.dtd` finish the audit (rc 0) and a bad subset get read and rejected (rc 254) without echoing the marker. The general-entity case did not expand. The reviewer’s extra no-DOCTYPE control failed validation, so `ok.dtd` was actually used. The higher rating stays withdrawn: the invoker supplied the config and the file URI.

The static `BUFFER` race remains unresolved. Neither side ran it, so it is not a confirmed bug.
